messages:
maya: Heads-up — trying to coordinate a cross-repo merge. SDK PR #412 depends on API PR #987 (minor endpoint shape change) and console PR #210 needs the new client interface. Planning to merge them within the same merge window to avoid prod inconsistencies. Anyone object to a 2pm PST merge today?

vikram: 2pm PST works for me. I need a green CI on API first though — there's a flaky integration test I want to watch.

jen: +1 for 2pm. I can do approvals for console once SDK is ready. Can we add a quick checklist?

maya: checklist idea: 1) API tests passing + smoke, 2) SDK build + integration with console, 3) helm chart bump and image tag, 4) rollouts + canary config. I'll paste the helm command we'll use after bump.

sam: quick note — SDK change touches auth header shape. Console will need to use `client.setAuth({token})` instead of `client.auth = token`. I pushed a small compatibility shim in the console PR to avoid hotfixes.

vikram: CI on API is currently red — failing in schema-validation step. Small mismatch in `userProfile` optional fields. I'm on it, should be fixed in ~30m.

ci-bot: API PR #987: status change -> failed (schema-validation). https://ci.local/build/987

jen: I can queue the console PR for review now. Please @me when SDK is green.

maya: copied. Also, helm chart needs `image.tag` set to the SDK runtime artifact tag after the API merge. Command we'll run for canary:```bash
helm upgrade platform-runtime ./charts/runtime --set image.tag=sha-abc123 --namespace prod --wait --timeout 10m
```

sam: re: canary, let's do 5% traffic for 30m then 100% if no errors. SRE: any objections? @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: fine with the plan. Please ensure we have log-level=debug for the first 10 minutes and alert on 5xx spike (threshold 0.5%).

vikram: pushed fix for schema, re-running CI.

ci-bot: API PR #987: status change -> success.

maya: great. SDK CI is now flaky on a test `kv-cache-invalidation` in integration that only fails on older images. Sam: can you rebase SDK onto latest runtime image?

sam: rebased and force-pushed to SDK PR #412. Triggering CI.

ci-bot: SDK PR #412: status change -> flaky (rerun suggested).

jen: I'll give console approval contingent on SDK green.

maya: if SDK CI hiccups again, can we do a manual smoke with the built artifact? I can run a quick local integration against staging API and console to validate.

sam: yes, ping me and I'll upload the artifact. Also noting we need a minor readme update in console about the auth shim — added comment in PR.

ci-bot: SDK PR #412: status change -> success.

jen: approving console PR #210 now. :thumbsup:

maya: approving SDK PR #412.

vikram: API already merged (fast-forward).

ci-bot: Merged: API PR #987 into main by vikram.

maya: merging SDK next, then console. I'll merge during the 2pm PST window. Leaving a note for rollback plan: helm rollback to previous release and a comment to disable routing if we see 5xx > threshold.

sam: merging SDK now.

ci-bot: Merged: SDK PR #412 into main by sam.

sam: kicked the helm chart bump PR — https://repo/charts/pull/58 — updated image.tag to sha-abc123.

maya: launching helm canary (5%) now.```bash
helm upgrade platform-runtime ./charts/runtime --set image.tag=sha-abc123 --namespace prod --wait --timeout 10m````

ci-bot: helm deploy started for release platform-runtime (canary 5%).

sre-oncall: monitoring — logs show one transient 502 spike, under threshold. continuing.

jen: console merged once canary is green. Will follow with post-merge verification checklist.

maya: canary stable for 30m, promoting to 100% now.

ci-bot: helm deploy completed -> success. platform-runtime at sha-abc123.

sre-oncall: all checks good, no error budget burns. Rolling back not needed.

maya: thanks everyone. Quick retro: next time, let's call out exact PR numbers in the merge window message and assign a single merge owner for cross-repo merges to avoid sequencing confusion.

vikram: agreed. I'll volunteer next time.

sam: thanks — will add a tiny script to validate compatibility matrix pre-merge (SDK/API/console) and post a summary in the thread.

jen: LGTM.

maya: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
